title: SAP BTP Admin
description:
**About This Job**
**GyanSys Inc.**
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 IT Services and IT Consulting
   

  

**Job Description**
 Here's a LinkedIn\-ready job posting version — punchy hook up top, key details scannable, JD substance preserved:
   

  

 We're Hiring: SAP BTP Cloud Platform Administrator \| Bangalore
   

  

 Love owning the backbone of enterprise SAP innovation? We're looking for a BTP Platform Admin to be the go\-to person keeping our SAP Business Technology Platform secure, stable, and cost\-smart — while enabling developers, architects, and integration teams to build without friction.
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Role: ERP Cloud Platform Admin – SAP BTP
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 Administer Global Accounts across BTP and cloud\-based SAP solutions
   

  

 Be the primary point of contact for BTP developers, integration teams \& architects
   

  

 Monitor logs, quotas, service instances \& platform alerts
   

  

 Drive cost optimization and forecasting across enterprise spend
   

  

 Partner with architecture teams to set BTP standards \& best practices
   

  

 Ensure compliance with GxP \& SOX on every change/enhancement
   

  

**What You Bring**
 ✅ Bachelor's in Engineering/CS or related field
   

  

 ✅ 5\+ years managing SAP BTP \& cloud\-based SAP solutions (Global ERP landscapes)
   

  

 ✅ Hands\-on expertise with BTP Global Accounts, Directories, Subaccounts — entitlements, quotas, subscriptions across Dev/Test/Prod
   

  

 ✅ Strong grip on SAP IAS, role collections, least\-privilege access
   

  

 ✅ Experience with Cloud Connector, Connectivity service, destinations, certificates, principal propagation
   

  

 ✅ Familiarity with Integration Suite, HANA Cloud, Process Automation
   

  

 ✅ Working knowledge of Cloud Foundry and/or Kyma
   

  

 ✅ Bonus: SAP BASIS/HANA tuning experience, Life Sciences/Pharma domain exposure, GxP compliance know\-how
   

  

 Why this role?
   

  

 You'll sit at the intersection of architecture, governance, and hands\-on operations — shaping how a global enterprise scales its SAP ecosystem securely and cost\-effectively.
   

  

 Interested? Apply now or tag someone who'd be a great fit!
